name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Enterprise-grade AI discoverability and on-site engagement audit marketplace. Deterministic, evidence-backed, no model weights, no headless browser.
author: Adobe Hackathon Team

skills.description: Master entrypoint. Composes all specialist skills, enforces the cross-web corroboration contract, and emits the final audit report JSON.
Crawl Access: robots.txt AI-agent disallow, multi-UA WAF detection, redirect hop counting, llms.txt discovery.
Rendering Parity: CSR hydration gap (static vs JS-hydrated word count), visual data trap detection, semantic noise floor / DOM depth.
JSON-LD entity anchor validation, sameAs disambiguation URI check, Schema.org completeness scoring.
Cross-Web Corroboration: Wikidata entity corroboration, DuckDuckGo Lite temporal freshness delta. Emits the Cross-Web Output Contract consumed by engagement-audit.
On-Site Engagement: Intent mismatch, hidden hash anchor trap, CTA above-hero boundary, full-screen overlay detection, web-to-AI price divergence, boilerplate noise ratio.

Content Signals: FAQ schema, breadcrumb schema, HowTo schema, Open Graph completeness, Twitter Card, canonical URL consistency, hreflang correctness, Sitemap freshness, Core Web Vitals proxies via resource hints.
Validates all findings against the output schema, deduplicates, sorts by severity, and serializes the final JSON + HTML dashboard report.
